title: 13 Children Rescued After Kindergarten Hostage-Taking in Itaperuna, Rio de Janeiro
detail: Thirteen children were rescued after a hostage-taking at a kindergarten in Itaperuna, Rio de Janeiro state. Security forces shot and killed the attacker, ending the standoff. No children were reported injured.
